title: Target anatomy
view: Transverse section of the right ankle just above the tip of the medial malleolus, under a probe transverse between the malleolus and the Achilles tendon, as on ultrasound: anterior (malleolus) on the image left, posterior (Achilles) on the right. Composition after NYSORA's plate (concept only).
teachingPoint: Under the flexor retinaculum the tibial nerve lies just posterior to the posterior tibial artery and its veins; inject into the sheath around the nerve.
claims: Probe transverse behind the medial malleolus (record).
Posterior tibial artery with paired veins; the nerve immediately posterior to the artery (record).

Artery, veins and nerve under the flexor retinaculum in one fascial sheath; tibialis posterior and flexor digitorum longus tendons just behind the malleolus; flexor hallucis longus deep; Achilles posterior (standard anatomy; house style for the sheath).
Needle in-plane from the posterior end, tip beside the nerve inside its sheath (record: in-plane; NYSORA: posterior end, fascial plane enveloping the nerve).
Teal: spread around the nerve (record: inject around the nerve).
Labels: Flexor retinaculum, Tibial nerve, Posterior tibial artery, Medial malleolus, Achilles tendon, Flexor hallucis longus.
